Heartbroken, Aria climbed to the highest peak and sang one final song—a melody so pure and sorrowful that it split her spirit in two. Half of her remained on the mountain, while the other half scattered into every canyon, cave, and valley across the world.

From that day forward, whenever anyone called out into these empty spaces, Aria's fragmented spirit would answer back, repeating their words in her voice. This was her gift to the world: proof that nothing we say is ever truly lost, and that even in our loneliest moments, something always calls back.

This is how echoes came to be—the eternal song of a love that could never quite reach its destination.
